$comment: Banned terms for `pnpm check:terms`. Each word is matched as a whole word (plus simple plurals) in identifiers, file names and migration SQL under apps/ and packages/, after splitting on camelCase, snake_case and punctuation. An exception names one exact identifier or file path that is allowed, with the reason.

exceptions.reason: Drizzle's migrator option name (drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator), not Ping vocabulary.
